SE Networks are described as the ILSVRC 2017 winner and as adding content-aware adaptive channel weighting to standard CNNs.

The SE block is described as a lightweight gating mechanism: squeeze each feature map to one numeric value, forming a C-vector, pass it through a two-layer neural network that outputs another C-vector, then use those C values to scale the original feature maps.
